Name: Recolored Bricks for Alternative Textures
Author: Ameyana
Description:
This is just the vanilla brick path recolored in several natural colors for Alternative Textures.

Also included is a separate file that has less natural colors, and looks shinier, closer to gold, silver, bronze, and rose gold. Install one or both, if you'd like.

I would like to do a pastel version/general colored version later down the line.

Requirements:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] (and its dependencies)

Each time you place a brick path, you'll get a random chance for the tile to be a different color/texture. In order to make your paths more consistent, you'll have to pick up the paint bucket tool from Robin.

Downloads.Description: Natural looking brick paths - for use with Alternative Textures Version 6.1.1 or higher. (They changed the naming convention of bricks to match the name of brick floors in vanilla, which  means the naming convention in these files had to be updated too.)
